sentences.en: LINDA: Hello, Linda speaking
sentences.zh: LINDA: 你好，我是琳达。

sentences.en: MATT: Oh hi, Linda
sentences.zh: MATT: 哦，你好，琳达。

sentences.en: This is Matt Brooks
sentences.zh: 我是马特·布鲁克斯。

sentences.en: Alex White gave me your number
sentences.zh: 亚历克斯·怀特把你的电话号码给了我。

sentences.en: He said you'd be able to give me some advice about moving to Banford
sentences.zh: 他说你能给我一些关于搬到班福德的建议。

sentences.en: LINDA: Yes, Alex did mention you
sentences.zh: LINDA: 是的，亚历克斯提到过你。

sentences.en: How can I help?
sentences.zh: 有什么我可以帮忙的吗？

sentences.en: MATT: Well, first of all - which area to live in?
sentences.zh: MATT: 嗯，首先——该住在哪个区域呢？

sentences.en: LINDA: a Well, I live in Dalton, which is a really nice suburb - not too expensive, and there's Example a nice park
sentences.zh: LINDA: 呃，我住在达尔顿，那是个非常不错的郊区——房价不太贵，而且还有一个不错的公园。（示例）

sentences.en: MATT: Sounds good
sentences.zh: MATT: 听起来不错。

sentences.en: DO you know how much it would be to rent a two bedroom flat there?
sentences.zh: 你知道在那里租一套两居室的公寓大概要多少钱吗？

sentences.en: LINDA: Yeah, you should be able to get something reasonable for 850 pounds per month
sentences.zh: LINDA: 是的，你应该能以每月850英镑左右的价格租到一套性价比不错的房子。

sentences.en: That's what people typically pay
sentences.zh: 这正是人们通常支付的租金。

sentences.en: You certainly wouldn't want to pay more than 900 pounds
sentences.zh: 你当然不想付超过900英镑。

sentences.en: That doesn't include bills or anything
sentences.zh: 这个价格不包括水电费等其他费用。

sentences.en: MATT: No
sentences.zh: MATT: 不包括。

sentences.en: That sounds alright
sentences.zh: 听起来还可以。

sentences.en: I'll definitely have a look there
sentences.zh: 我一定会去那里看看。

sentences.en: Are the transport links easy from where you live?
sentences.zh: 从你住的地方交通方便吗？

sentences.en: LINDA: Well, I'm very lucky
sentences.zh: LINDA: 呃，我非常幸运。

sentences.en: I work in the city centre so I don't have to use public transport
sentences.zh: 我在市中心工作，所以不用乘坐公共交通工具。

sentences.en: I go by bike
sentences.zh: 我骑自行车去上班。

sentences.en: MATT: Oh, I wish I could do that
sentences.zh: MATT: 哦，真希望我也能这样。

sentences.en: Is it safe to cycle around the city?
sentences.zh: 在城里骑自行车安全吗？

sentences.en: LINDA: Yes, it's fine
sentences.zh: LINDA: 是的，完全没问题。

sentences.en: And it keeps me fit
sentences.zh: 而且还能让我保持健康。

sentences.en: Anyway, driving to work in the city centre would be nightmare because there's hardly any parking
sentences.zh: 再说，在市中心开车上班会是一场噩梦，因为几乎找不到停车位。

sentences.en: And the traffic during the rush hour can be bad
sentences.zh: 而且高峰时段的交通状况可能很糟糕。

sentences.en: MATT: I'd be working from home but I'd have to go to London one or two days a week
sentences.zh: MATT: 我会在家办公，但每周需要去伦敦一两天。

sentences.en: LINDA: Oh, that's perfect
sentences.zh: LINDA: 哦，那太好了。

sentences.en: Getting to London is no problem
sentences.zh: 去伦敦完全不成问题。

sentences.en: There's a fast train every 30 minutes which only takes 45 minutes
sentences.zh: 每30分钟就有一趟快速列车，仅需45分钟。

sentences.en: MATT: That's good
sentences.zh: MATT: 那很好。

sentences.en: LINDA: Yeah, the train service isn't bad during the week
sentences.zh: LINDA: 是的，工作日的火车服务还不错。

sentences.en: And they run quite late at night
sentences.zh: 而且晚上运营时间也相当晚。

sentences.en: It's weekends that are a problem
sentences.zh: 真正成问题的是周末。

sentences.en: They're always doing engineering work and you have to take a bus to Hadham and pick up the train there, which is really slow
sentences.zh: 他们总是在进行工程维修，你得坐公交车去哈德姆，再在那里换乘火车，那可慢多了。

sentences.en: But other than that, Banford's a great place to live
sentences.zh: 不过除此之外，班福德真是个居住的好地方。

sentences.en: I've never been happier
sentences.zh: 我从未像现在这样开心过。

sentences.en: LINDA: There are some nice restaurants in the city centre and a brand new cinema which a has only been open a couple of months
sentences.zh: LINDA: 市中心有一些不错的餐厅，还有一家全新的电影院，才开业几个月。

sentences.en: There's a good arts centre too
sentences.zh: 那里还有一个不错的艺术中心。

sentences.en: MATT: Sounds like Banford's got it all
sentences.zh: MATT: 听起来班福德样样俱全啊。

sentences.en: LINDA: Yes!
sentences.zh: LINDA: 没错！

sentences.en: We're really lucky
sentences.zh: 我们真的很幸运。

sentences.en: There are lots of really good aspects to living here
sentences.zh: 住在这里有很多非常棒的方面。

sentences.en: The schools are good and the hospital here is one of the best in the country
sentences.zh: 学校很好，这里的医院也是全国最好的医院之一。

sentences.en: Everyone | know who's been there's had a positive experience
sentences.zh: 所有去过那儿的人都有积极的体验。

sentences.en: Oh, I can give you the name of my dentist too in Bridge Street, if you're interested
sentences.zh: 哦，如果你感兴趣的话，我还可以把我在桥街的牙医的名字告诉你。

sentences.en: I've been going to him for years and I've never had any problems
sentences.zh: 我多年来一直找他看牙，从未遇到过任何问题。

sentences.en: MATT: Oh, OK
sentences.zh: MATT: 哦，好的。

sentences.en: Thanks!
sentences.zh: 谢谢！

sentences.en: LINDA: I'll find his number and send it to you
sentences.zh: LINDA: 我会找到他的电话号码，然后发给你。

sentences.en: MATT: Thanks, that would be really helpful
sentences.zh: MATT: 谢谢，这真的会非常有帮助。

sentences.en: LINDA: Are you planning to visit Banford soon?
sentences.zh: LINDA: 你们打算近期去班福德参观吗？

sentences.en: MATT: Yes
sentences.zh: MATT: 是的。

sentences.en: My wife and I are both coming next week
sentences.zh: 我和我妻子下周都会过去。

sentences.en: We want to make some appointments with estate agents
sentences.zh: 我们想预约几家房产中介。

sentences.en: LINDA: could meet you if you like and show you around
sentences.zh: LINDA: 如果你们愿意的话，我可以和你们见面，带你们四处看看。

sentences.en: MATT: Are you sure?
sentences.zh: MATT: 你确定吗？

sentences.en: We'd really appreciate that
sentences.zh: 我们真的非常感激。

sentences.en: LINDA: Either a Tuesday or Thursday is good for me, after 5.30
sentences.zh: LINDA: 我星期二或星期四都可以，五点半之后有空。

sentences.en: MATT: Thursday's preferable - Tuesday I need to get home before 6 pm
sentences.zh: MATT: 星期四更好——星期二我需要在下午六点前回家。

sentences.en: LINDA: OK
sentences.zh: LINDA: 好的。

sentences.en: Great
sentences.zh: 太好了。

sentences.en: Let me know which train you're catching and I'll meet you in the café outside
sentences.zh: 请告诉我你们乘坐哪趟火车，我会在车站外的咖啡馆等你们。

sentences.en: You can't miss it
sentences.zh: 你们肯定不会错过它。

sentences.en: It's opposite the station and next to the museum
sentences.zh: 它就在车站对面，紧邻博物馆。

sentences.en: MATT: Brilliant
sentences.zh: MATT: 太棒了。

sentences.en: I'll text you next week then. hanks so much for all the advice
sentences.zh: 那我下周就给你发短信。非常感谢你的所有建议。

sentences.en: LINDA: No problem
sentences.zh: LINDA: 没问题。

sentences.en: I'll see you next week
sentences.zh: 下周见。
